learning_outcomes.text: The student can apply the basic concepts of virtualization in Linux namespaces and cgroups and build working basic virtual machines via KVM and Qemu.
The student can set up and use an environment with LXC and Docker to create containers with persistent data volumes.
The student can set up, secure, and manage a fully redundant and clustered Proxmox environment, including virtual networks and network-based datastores.

syllabus_topics: Container-based virtualization, namespaces in Linux, LXC, Docker
Lab assignments related to: Container-based virtualization, namespaces in Linux, LXC, Docker
Lab assignments related to: KVM, QEMU and libvirt
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with 50% for the theory part and 50% for the labs. A student who achieves less than 6/20 on one of the teaching and learning activities can still achieve a maximum of 9/20 for the entirety of the course unit. Resit is possible for the written theory exam; for labs, students can demonstrate completed assignments by appointment. Partial transfers of successful partial results (Theory, Lab) are possible within the academic year.
